# Techras i USA och Asien – Stockholmsbörsen mot röd öppning

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-06-23  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

A Börsfrukost morning macro episode with Handelsbanken FX strategist Michelle Gubel, centred on tech-led profit-taking and concentration risk after Wall Street and Asian tech sold off (Korea's Kospi halted, Samsung and SK Hynix plunging). The discussion covers dollar dominance pushing the yen to 40-year lows and a weak krona, an oil price that has settled structurally higher (~$77) but well below feared war-time spikes, and implications for the Riksbank. On equities the hosts see Stockholm opening down ~1% on profit-taking, argue Swedish/European valuations are relatively attractive versus the US but lack AI exposure, with US tech still the only real AI play despite higher volatility and concentration risk.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🔴 EPI-A — Epiroc | **SELL** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

UBS downgraded Epiroc to sell with a 230 SEK target; stock fell 4%, worst OMXS30 performer despite a strong year-to-date run.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst (UBS) issued a sell rating with a 230 SEK target after the stock had run strongly this year, implying limited upside/valuation stretch. Hosts reported it as the day's biggest OMXS30 decliner (-4%), reflecting market agreement with the downgrade.

#### Sell Triggers

- if UBS reverses the rating
- if the stock pulls back to near the 230 SEK target
- if mining-cycle demand strengthens

> *"I botten ser vi Epiroc som faller 4%. De har fått en sänkt rekommendation från UBS som sätter säljstämpel på Epiroc och en riktkurs på 230 kronor."*

---

### 🟡 TELIA — Telia | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Barclays upgraded Telia to equal weight from underweight; one of only three OMXS30 gainers on a down day.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst upgrade is only to neutral (equal weight) from underweight, signalling reduced bearishness rather than positive conviction. Defensive telecom held up as a few names bucked the broad ~1.4% index decline, supporting a hold stance.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Barclays reverts to underweight
- if defensive rotation reverses as risk appetite returns

> *"Telia höjs till jämnvikt från tidigare undervikt från Barclays och Telia är ju då ett av tre bolag på Omex S30 som stiger"*

---

### 🟢 OVZON — Octave | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Handelsbanken initiated coverage with a buy recommendation; stock rose half a percent against a falling market.

#### Reasoning

A cited analyst (Handelsbanken) launched coverage with a buy rating, a positive catalyst, and the stock outperformed by rising while the broad index fell ~1.4%. Conviction is moderate as it rests on a single fresh broker initiation reported by the hosts.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Handelsbanken downgrades
- if coverage thesis fails to materialise in next results

> *"Ser Octave stiga en halv procent. De har fått en köprekommendation från Handelsbanken som har inlett bevakning av bolaget"*

---

### 🟠 EQT — EQT | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Fell ~2% amid private-credit contagion fears after Apollo flagship fund redemptions rose to 17%, signalling falling returns and tension in private credit.

#### Reasoning

EQT dropped alongside broad private-credit worries triggered by elevated redemptions in Apollo's flagship retail credit fund (FT), raising concern over declining returns and stress in private credit markets. This is sentiment-driven contagion rather than EQT-specific news, so the directional view is cautious watch only.

#### Sell Triggers

- if private-credit redemption pressure intensifies
- if EQT reports fund-level outflows or markdowns

> *"EQT backar närmare 2% också. ... investerars inlösningsbegäran i Apollos flaggskeppsfond för privata krediter ... ökade till 17% av fondens värde under andra kvartalet."*

---
